description: Presenting an exceptional investment opportunity, this fully furnished studio apartment is located on the sixth floor of Block A, perfectly positioned in the vibrant heart of Liverpool City Centre. This property is currently tenanted, achieving a strong rental income of £780 per calendar month, making it an attractive proposition for investors seeking immediate returns. The studio boasts a contemporary design, with well-planned living and sleeping areas that maximise both comfort and functionality. High-quality furnishings are included, ensuring a seamless transition for both tenants and landlords. The modern kitchen is equipped with integrated appliances, sleek cabinetry, and ample workspace, catering to the needs of urban living. The stylish bathroom features quality fixtures and a clean, modern finish, providing a relaxing space for residents. Large windows allow for an abundance of natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere throughout the apartment. The property’s location in Liverpool City Centre places it within easy reach of an array of amenities, including shopping destinations, popular restaurants, and cultural landmarks. Essential transport links are situated in close proximity, offering excellent connectivity for commuting professionals, students, and visitors alike. The building itself benefits from secure entry systems and well-maintained communal areas, contributing to a safe and pleasant living environment. Investors will appreciate the strong rental demand in this sought-after city centre location, supported by the property’s proven tenancy record and the ongoing appeal of Liverpool as a thriving urban hub. Whether you are expanding your portfolio or seeking a high-yield addition, this studio represents a turnkey solution that combines immediate income with long-term investment potential. With its central location, quality furnishings, and reliable tenancy in place, this studio apartment offers a rare blend of convenience, comfort, and financial security. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the advantages this property has to offer in one of Liverpool’s most dynamic and desirable districts.
